title: No agents understand/generate/edit/organise media (text-centric roster)
body: BI-0190: media agents gated by capability packs.

rcca.root_cause: The agent roster was text-only; no media agents existed and packs had no agent bindings.
rcca.corrective: Added media-analyst/media-generator/media-editor/asset-librarian cards+specs, live knowledge bindings, and pack-gated composition (agents+4m stage) so they appear only when the pack is enabled.
rcca.preventive: Pack-gated (non-media runs unchanged); knowledge bindings resolve to live guidelines; audits (agent_card/role_prompt/knowledge) enforced green.
